description: Source code for the CryptoHalHidl class implementing Android DRM hardware abstraction layer using HIDL interfaces, managing crypto factories and plugins, performing decryption, and handling shared buffers.

classes.name: CryptoHalHidl
classes.description: Implementation of the DRM Crypto HAL using HIDL interfaces, managing crypto factories, plugins, shared buffers, and decryption operations.

methods.name: makeCryptoFactories
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of available ICryptoFactory instances by querying the Android service manager.

methods.name: makeCryptoPlugin
methods.description: Creates an ICryptoPlugin instance from a given factory, UUID, and initialization data.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Returns the current initialization status of the CryptoHalHidl instance.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given crypto scheme UUID is supported by any available factory.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates and initializes a crypto plugin for a specified UUID and data.

methods.name: destroyPlugin
methods.description: Destroys the current crypto plugin and resets the state.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder component is required for a given MIME type.

methods.name: setHeapBase
methods.description: Sets the base shared memory heap for buffer sharing.

methods.name: clearHeapBase
methods.description: Clears the shared memory heap mapping.

methods.name: checkSharedBuffer
methods.description: Validates a shared buffer's parameters against the set heaps.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of data using the crypto plugin, handling different modes and buffer types.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of display resolution changes.

methods.name: setMediaDrmSession
methods.description: Sets the MediaDRM session ID in the crypto plugin.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages from the crypto plugin.
